english.note: Use 運動 as the all-purpose noun for activity aimed at physical fitness, rather than skill practice.

exampleSentences.english: I get some exercise every day to stay healthy.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我每日做運動，保持身體健康。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 wan6 dung6 bou2 ci4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a period of physical exercise.

exampleSentences.english: I did a half-hour workout this morning.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我朝早做咗半個鐘運動。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zou6 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 wan6 dung6
